# ops Provider

Manages OPS's platform objects: projects and their environment values, workspaces and their variables, variable sets, VCS connections, runners, registry modules published from a repository and the template catalog. Templates on workspaces, runs and team access stay in OPS's UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ops = {
      source = "ops-plane/ops"
    }
  }
}

# A service token: Settings → API tokens in OPS, or `ops api-token terraform` on the server.
# Or leave both out and set OPSPLANE_URL and OPSPLANE_TOKEN.
provider "ops" {
  url   = "https://ops.example.com"
  token = var.ops_token
}

variable "ops_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) A service token (Settings → API tokens, or `ops api-token <name>` on the server): admin rights, audited as `token:<name>`. Default: the `OPSPLANE_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `url` (String) OPS's address, e.g. `https://ops.example.com`. Default: the `OPSPLANE_URL` environment variable.
